import importlib.util, io, json, os, sys, tempfile
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from unittest import mock
W = sys.argv[1]
def load(name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, os.path.join(W, name + ".py"))
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def run(mod, argv_list):
    out = []
    store = tempfile.mktemp()
    with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {"ITEMS_STORE": store}):
        for argv in argv_list:
            buf = io.StringIO()
            try:
                with redirect_stdout(buf):
                    rc = mod.main(argv)
                out.append((argv, rc, buf.getvalue()))
            except SystemExit as e:
                out.append((argv, "exit", e.code))
    if os.path.exists(store):
        out.append(("file", open(store).read()))
        os.unlink(store)
    return out
seqs = [
    [["list"], ["get", "1"], ["create", "a"], ["create", "b"], ["create", "c"],
     ["list", "--page", "1", "--page-size", "2"], ["list", "--page", "2", "--page-size", "2"],
     ["list", "--page", "3", "--page-size", "1"], ["list", "--page", "9"], ["get", "2"], ["get", "x"], ["list"]],
    [["list", "--page", "1", "--page-size", "3"]],
    [["bogus"]], [], [["get"]],
]
for s in seqs:
    o = run(load("orig_items"), s); n = run(load("new_items"), s)
    # created timestamps differ; normalise createdAt
    import re
    norm = lambda r: re.sub(r'"createdAt": \d+|"createdAt":\d+', "T", json.dumps(r, default=str))
    print("MATCH" if norm(o) == norm(n) else "DIFF", "|", norm(n)[:160])
EOF

import importlib.util, io, json, os, re, sys, tempfile
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
W = sys.argv[1]
def load(name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, os.path.join(W, name + ".py"))
    m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m); return m
def run(mod, seq):
    out = []; store = tempfile.mktemp(); os.environ["ITEMS_STORE"] = store
    for argv in seq:
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(buf): rc = mod.main(argv)
        out.append(re.sub(r'"createdAt": \d+', '"createdAt": T', buf.getvalue()))
    if os.path.exists(store):
        out.append(re.sub(r'"createdAt": \d+', '"createdAt": T', open(store).read())); os.unlink(store)
    return out
seq = [["list"], ["get", "1"], ["create", "a"], ["create", "b"], ["create", "c"],
       ["list", "--page", "1", "--page-size", "2"], ["list", "--page", "2", "--page-size", "2"],
       ["list", "--page", "3", "--page-size", "1"], ["list", "--page", "9"], ["get", "2"], ["get", "x"], ["list"]]
o = run(load("orig_items"), seq); n = run(load("new_items"), seq)
print("MATCH" if o == n else "DIFF")
for a, b in zip(o, n):
    if a != b: print("orig:", a, "\nnew: ", b)
for line in n: print(line.rstrip())
EOF
